name: Orby
bio: Kit's floating robot buddy on Starbase Nine in Starbase Spooky, while Captain Ada Comet is at Moon Base.

portrait.subject: a super cute round floating helper robot with one big friendly blue eye, little propeller ears and a tiny star sticker
portrait.background: cosy 16-bit space station with planets in the window

request: Beep boop! Orby from Starbase Spooky! Kit says we need more friends. You? 🛰️
hello: Captain Comet is away for five days. We're in charge! Gulp.
about: I'm Orby! I help Kit, the Junior Station Keeper, run Starbase Nine. Spooky things keep happening! But we figure them out!
how: Point and click: help Kit and Orby run the starbase for five days, solve puzzles, learn space facts and solve the spooky mystery.
tips: Click everything! Orby knows lots of facts.
Write down the clues from each day.
Ask Captain Comet on the radio if you're stuck!
chat: Did you know Saturn could float in a giant bathtub? Beep!
Kit and I made space pancakes. They floated away.
Something went BOOP in the cargo bay. Spooky!
I counted all the stars I can see. 2,104!
nudge: A new day on the starbase! Help us? 🛰️
idle: {ago}! Kit and I miss you! Beep...
The starbase was quiet for {ago}. Too quiet!
progress: We're on day {day}! Captain Comet comes back soon!

questions.q: Space quiz! Which planet is biggest?
a: Earth is home, but Jupiter's way bigger!

update: Beep! Starbase Spooky got updated to v{version}! 🛰️

sprite.subject: a super cute round floating helper robot with one big friendly blue eye, little propeller ears, two little arms and a tiny star sticker, hovering
